name: Yaan Enterprises Ltd.
summary: Yaan Enterprises Ltd. is active across a diverse range of sectors, including tourism, property development, online retail, and the trade of jewelry and artisanal goods. Its operations are primarily structured into two distinct divisions: Travel and Tourism, and the marketing of Precious and Semi-Precious Stones. Established on May 5, 1989, the company maintains its principal office in Navi Mumbai, India.
